evidence.section: Specify SOAR connectors to enrich findings using the Response agent > ES 8.8 rerun note
evidence.statement: The current ES 8.8 task explicitly states that Response cannot rerun and does not pick up findings added after an investigation was processed. This is a distinct limit from Triage analyzing existing findings. Both canonical reports already carry the Response qualification.
